grilled_cheese.title: Classic Grilled Cheese
steps: Spread soft butter on one side of two bread slices.
Place one slice butter-side down in a medium skillet.
Add two slices of cheddar cheese onto the bread.
Place the second slice on top, butter-side up.
Cook for three minutes until golden, then flip.
Cook two more minutes and serve immediately.

scrambled_eggs.title: Fluffy Scrambled Eggs
steps: Whisk two eggs and a pinch of salt in a bowl.
Heat a non-stick pan over low heat with a knob of butter.
Pour the eggs into the pan.
Gently stir with a spatula until soft curds form.
Remove from heat while still slightly wet to avoid overcooking.

chocolate_mug_cake.title: Chocolate Mug Cake
steps: Mix four tablespoons of flour and two tablespoons of cocoa in a mug.
Add two tablespoons of sugar and a pinch of baking powder.
Stir in three tablespoons of milk and one tablespoon of oil.
Microwave on high for ninety seconds.
Let it cool for one minute before eating.

pancakes.title: Classic Pancakes
steps: In a bowl, whisk together the flour, baking powder, sugar, and salt.
Add the milk, egg, and melted butter, then whisk just until the batter comes together; a few small lumps are fine.
Heat a lightly buttered nonstick pan over medium heat. When the pan is hot, pour about one quarter cup of batter for each pancake.
Cook until bubbles form on the surface and the edges look set, about 2 minutes.
Flip the pancake and cook the other side until golden brown, about 1 to 2 minutes.
Transfer the pancakes to a plate and serve warm with your preferred toppings.

vegetable_omelette.title: Vegetable Omelette
steps: Beat the eggs with salt and black pepper in a bowl.
Heat the butter in a nonstick pan over medium heat.
Cook the onion and bell pepper until slightly softened.
Add the tomato, then pour the beaten eggs over the vegetables.
Cook until the edges set, then fold the omelette and cook until just set.

french_toast.title: French Toast
steps: Whisk the eggs, milk, sugar, and cinnamon in a shallow bowl.
Dip each bread slice into the mixture, coating both sides.
Heat the butter in a skillet over medium heat.
Cook the bread for about 2 minutes per side until golden.
Serve warm with fruit or syrup.

masala_dosa.title: Masala Dosa
steps: Boil the potatoes until tender, peel them, and roughly mash them.
Heat one tablespoon of oil and temper the mustard seeds.
Add sliced onion and green chili and cook until the onion softens.
Add the mashed potatoes and salt, then mix and cook for 2 minutes.
Heat a dosa pan, spread batter into a thin circle, and drizzle with oil.
Cook until crisp, place potato filling in the center, fold, and serve.

vegetable_upma.title: Vegetable Upma
steps: Dry roast the semolina over low heat until lightly fragrant, then set aside.
Heat oil and temper the mustard seeds.
Add onion, carrot, and peas and cook until the vegetables soften.
Add water and salt and bring the mixture to a boil.
Slowly add the roasted semolina while stirring continuously.
Cook for about 3 minutes until thick, then serve hot.

poha.title: Vegetable Poha
steps: Rinse the flattened rice briefly and let it drain.
Heat oil and fry the peanuts until lightly golden, then set them aside.
Temper the mustard seeds, then cook the onion, potato, and green chili until tender.
Add the rinsed flattened rice and salt and mix gently.
Cook for 3 to 4 minutes, then fold in the peanuts and serve.

chicken_biryani.title: Chicken Biryani
steps: Rinse the basmati rice and soak it for 20 minutes.
Marinate the chicken with yogurt, ginger-garlic paste, biryani masala, and salt.
Cook the onions in oil until golden, then add tomatoes and cook until soft.
Add the marinated chicken and cook until it is mostly done.
Parboil the soaked rice until the grains are partly cooked, then drain.
Layer the rice over the chicken, cover, and cook on low heat for 15 minutes.
Rest the biryani for 5 minutes before gently mixing and serving.

chana_masala.title: Chana Masala
steps: Heat oil in a pan and cook the onion until golden.
Add ginger-garlic paste and cook for 30 seconds.
Add tomatoes and cook until they become soft and thick.
Stir in chana masala and salt.
Add chickpeas and water and simmer for 10 minutes.
Lightly mash a few chickpeas to thicken the gravy, then serve.

palak_paneer.title: Palak Paneer
steps: Blanch the spinach in boiling water for 2 minutes and cool it immediately.
Blend the spinach into a smooth puree.
Heat oil and cook the onion until soft, then add ginger-garlic paste.
Add the tomato and cook until soft.
Stir in the spinach puree and simmer for 5 minutes.
Add paneer and cream and simmer gently for another 3 minutes.

dal_tadka.title: Dal Tadka
steps: Rinse the lentils and cook them with water, tomato, onion, and salt until soft.
Whisk the cooked lentils until smooth and adjust the consistency with water.
Heat ghee in a small pan and add cumin seeds.
Add sliced garlic and cook until lightly golden.
Pour the tempering over the dal and simmer for 2 minutes before serving.

rajma_chawal.title: Rajma Chawal
steps: Rinse the rice and cook it until the grains are tender, then set aside.
Heat oil and cook the onion until golden.
Add ginger-garlic paste and tomatoes and cook until thick.
Add garam masala, salt, and kidney beans with a little water.
Simmer the rajma for 12 minutes until the gravy thickens.
Serve the rajma hot over the cooked rice.

vegetable_fried_rice.title: Vegetable Fried Rice
steps: Heat oil in a large wok over high heat.
Stir-fry the carrot, peas, and bell pepper for 2 minutes.
Add the cooked rice and toss continuously for 2 minutes.
Add soy sauce and toss until the rice is evenly seasoned.
Add spring onion, toss for 30 seconds, and serve hot.

chicken_fried_rice.title: Chicken Fried Rice
steps: Heat one tablespoon of oil and scramble the eggs until just set, then remove them.
Add the remaining oil and stir-fry the carrot for 1 minute.
Add the cooked chicken and rice and toss over high heat.
Return the eggs to the wok and add soy sauce.
Toss for 2 minutes, add spring onion, and serve.

tomato_pasta.title: Tomato Garlic Pasta
steps: Cook the pasta in salted water until just tender, then reserve half a cup of pasta water.
Heat olive oil and cook the garlic for 30 seconds.
Add the tomatoes and simmer for 8 minutes until saucy.
Add the cooked pasta and a splash of pasta water and toss well.
Stir in parmesan and serve immediately.

garlic_butter_pasta.title: Garlic Butter Pasta
steps: Cook the spaghetti in salted water until tender and reserve half a cup of pasta water.
Melt the butter in a skillet over low heat.
Add minced garlic and cook for about 30 seconds without browning it.
Add the spaghetti and enough pasta water to make the sauce glossy.
Toss with parmesan and black pepper and serve.

vegetable_stir_fry.title: Vegetable Stir-Fry
steps: Mix the soy sauce, garlic, and ginger in a small bowl.
Heat oil in a wok over high heat.
Stir-fry the broccoli and carrot for 2 minutes.
Add the bell pepper and stir-fry for another 2 minutes.
Add the sauce and toss for 1 minute before serving.

grilled_chicken.title: Grilled Chicken
steps: Mix olive oil, lemon juice, garlic, paprika, and salt into a marinade.
Coat the chicken with the marinade and let it rest for 15 minutes.
Heat a grill pan or grill over medium-high heat.
Grill the chicken for about 5 to 7 minutes per side until fully cooked.
Rest the chicken for 5 minutes before slicing and serving.

chicken_tacos.title: Chicken Tacos
steps: Slice the chicken and toss it with chili powder and lime juice.
Heat oil in a skillet and cook the chicken until fully cooked.
Add onion and bell pepper and cook until slightly softened.
Warm the tortillas in a dry pan for about 20 seconds per side.
Fill the tortillas with the chicken mixture and serve.

tomato_soup.title: Tomato Soup
steps: Melt the butter and cook the onion and garlic until soft.
Add chopped tomatoes and cook for 5 minutes.
Add the vegetable stock and simmer for 15 minutes.
Blend the soup until smooth.
Season with salt and black pepper and simmer for another 2 minutes.

lentil_soup.title: Lentil Soup
steps: Heat oil and cook the onion and carrot for 4 minutes.
Add tomato and cumin and cook for 1 minute.
Add lentils and vegetable stock and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat and simmer for 18 minutes until the lentils are soft.
Blend part of the soup if desired, then season and serve.

chocolate_chip_cookies.title: Chocolate Chip Cookies
steps: Cream the softened butter with the brown sugar and white sugar.
Beat in the egg until smooth.
Mix in the flour, baking soda, and salt until a dough forms.
Fold in the chocolate chips.
Scoop the dough onto a lined baking tray with space between portions.
Bake at 180 degrees Celsius for about 10 to 12 minutes until the edges are golden.
Cool the cookies on the tray for 5 minutes before serving.

banana_bread.title: Banana Bread
steps: Mash the bananas in a large bowl.
Stir in melted butter, sugar, and eggs.
Mix in the flour, baking soda, and salt until just combined.
Pour the batter into a greased loaf pan.
Bake at 175 degrees Celsius for about 50 to 60 minutes.
Cool the loaf for 10 minutes before slicing.

brownies.title: Fudgy Brownies
steps: Melt the butter and let it cool slightly.
Whisk in the sugar, eggs, and vanilla extract.
Stir in the cocoa powder, flour, and salt until just combined.
Spread the batter into a lined square baking pan.
Bake at 175 degrees Celsius for about 22 to 25 minutes.
Cool for at least 15 minutes before slicing.

mug_cake_vanilla.title: Vanilla Mug Cake
steps: Mix the flour, sugar, and baking powder in a microwave-safe mug.
Add milk, oil, and vanilla and stir until smooth.
Microwave on high for about 90 seconds.
Let the mug cake cool for 1 minute before eating.

overnight_oats.title: Overnight Oats
steps: Combine the oats, milk, yogurt, honey, and chia seeds in a jar.
Stir until evenly mixed.
Add sliced banana and gently fold it through.
Cover and refrigerate for at least 4 hours or overnight.
Stir before serving and add extra fruit if desired.

fruit_smoothie.title: Mixed Fruit Smoothie
steps: Add the banana, frozen berries, yogurt, milk, and honey to a blender.
Blend until smooth and creamy.
Taste and add more honey if needed.
Pour into glasses and serve immediately.

guacamole.title: Simple Guacamole
steps: Halve the avocados, remove the pits, and scoop the flesh into a bowl.
Mash the avocado with a fork until mostly smooth.
Fold in lime juice, tomato, onion, cilantro, and salt.
Taste and adjust the salt and lime juice.
Serve immediately.

hummus.title: Classic Hummus
steps: Add chickpeas, tahini, lemon juice, garlic, salt, and water to a blender.
Blend until smooth, scraping down the sides as needed.
Add more water one tablespoon at a time if the hummus is too thick.
Transfer to a bowl and drizzle with olive oil before serving.

vegetable_noodles.title: Vegetable Noodles
steps: Cook the noodles according to their package directions and drain them.
Heat oil in a wok and cook the garlic for 30 seconds.
Add carrot, bell pepper, and cabbage and stir-fry for 3 minutes.
Add the noodles and soy sauce and toss over high heat.
Cook for 2 minutes, then serve hot.

aloo_paratha.title: Aloo Paratha
steps: Mix the flour with water and a pinch of salt to make a soft dough, then rest it for 15 minutes.
Boil and mash the potatoes and mix them with chili, cumin, and salt.
Divide the dough and potato filling into equal portions.
Stuff each dough portion with potato filling and roll it into a flat round.
Cook each paratha on a hot skillet, brushing with oil, until golden on both sides.

vegetable_pulao.title: Vegetable Pulao
steps: Rinse and soak the basmati rice for 20 minutes.
Heat oil and fry the whole spices and onion until fragrant.
Add the mixed vegetables and cook for 3 minutes.
Add the drained rice, water, and salt and bring to a boil.
Cover and cook on low heat for about 15 minutes.
Rest for 5 minutes, fluff gently, and serve.
